instructions:
This MCP server wraps the live Revid public API.
Hosted remote MCP clients can authenticate with OAuth 2.1 and PKCE.
Header-configurable clients can authenticate with a Revid API key using `Authorization: Bearer <REVID_API_KEY>` or `x-revid-api-key`.
Use `search_viral_videos` to research what performs across platforms (transcripts, engagement data, viral tiers) before creating content.
Use `generate_media` to create standalone images or videos with the same options as the Revid media generator. It waits up to 40 seconds: a fast image comes back finished, a longer generation comes back as `processing` with `mediaIds`; then call `get_media_status` with them (each call waits up to 40 seconds too) until it is ready or failed. Never start the generation again to get its result: that pays twice.
Every media input takes a public URL. For a local file, call `create_upload_url`, PUT the bytes to its `uploadUrl`, then pass its `url`; do not use third-party file hosts, whose links often serve an HTML page instead of the file.
Use `render_video` to start a job, then poll with `get_project_status` until `videoUrl` is returned.
`export_video` waits up to 40 seconds the same way: when it returns `processing`, call `get_export_status` with its `exportId` until `ready` or `failed`.
When a video needs background music, set `music: { generateMusic: true }` in `render_video` (optionally with a `generationMusicPrompt` brief) rather than picking a library `trackName`: you cannot listen to library tracks, and generated music is written from the video's own script.
Use `list_voices`, `list_presets` and `list_music_tracks` to pick `voice.voiceId`, `media.mediaPreset`, `captions.preset` and `music.trackName` values for `render_video`.
For a series (recurring characters and places across episodes), use `create_episode` (Series Maker on Autopilot), poll `get_episode_status`, then `export_video` its `pid`; `list_series` finds a series to continue.
For songs, `render_video` with workflow `lyrics-to-video` (lyrics in `source.text`, or a song description in `source.prompt`) or `song-ad` (a jingle ad for a product); to put people from photos into an existing video, workflow `character-swap`.
For the full render payload reference, read the `revid://docs/render` resource.
Before `publish_now` or `schedule_publish`, call `list_social_accounts` to find the connected accounts (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, Facebook Pages, webhooks) and channels, then target them by id or handle.
Facebook Pages publishing is restricted to admins and the designated Meta review account while Meta review is pending. It is not generally available, and changing plans does not unlock Facebook Connect. Use only connected Pages returned by list_social_accounts.
Generation tools need an active Revid plan; credits alone do not unlock them. When a tool returns 402 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED, tell the user that these tools need an active Revid plan on their account.

tools.name: generate_media
tools.title: Generate media
tools.description: Generate standalone image or video media using the same prompt, quality, ratio, preset, duration, frame, reference, audio, and character options as the Revid media generator. The media is saved to the user's Revid media library. The call waits up to 40 seconds. A generation done by then returns status "ready" with each media's url. A longer one (ultra images often, videos usually: 1 to 10 minutes) returns status "processing" with mediaIds: call `get_media_status` with them until the status is ready or failed. Do not call generate_media again for the same request while it is processing: every call starts and charges a new generation. Requires an active Revid plan.

audio.description: For videos, add audio to generated output. Defaults to true; pass false for a silent clip.

count.description: Image count. Videos generate one item, matching the media generator UI.

generationPreset.description: Optional Revid media generator preset value.

improvePrompt.description: Improve the image/video prompt before generation.

mediaType.description: Media type to generate. Defaults to image.

prompt.description: Media prompt. You can also use source.prompt or input.

quality.description: Image or video quality, same values as the media generator UI.

referenceAudios.description: Audio reference URLs for video generation.

referenceVideos.description: Video reference URLs for video generation.

voiceId.description: Optional voice id for generated video audio processing.

tools.name: get_media_status
tools.title: Get media status
tools.description: Follow a `generate_media` call that returned status "processing": pass its mediaIds. Waits up to waitSeconds (default 40) for the generation to finish, then returns status "ready" with each media's url, "failed" with the reason, or still "processing": then call it again with the same mediaIds. Images usually take under a minute, videos 1 to 10 minutes; a media still generating after an hour fails with Timeout. Requires an active Revid plan.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the generation to finish before answering, 0 to 40. Default 40; 0 checks once.

tools.name: render_video
tools.title: Render video
tools.description: Start a new Revid render using the v3 public API. Returns a `pid` you can poll with `get_project_status`. Requires an active Revid plan.

input.description: Generic content alias used by the public API.

bRollFrequency.description: video-to-clips: how often B-roll appears, from 0 to 1. Default 0.5.

mediaPreset.description: Visual style preset slug (DEFAULT, ANIME, PIXAR, ...; see `revid://docs/render`). With media.type motion-graphics it is the motion graphics category instead, like the create form: MOTION_INSPIRATION_AUTO (Auto, default: Let the agent choose the best category and reference for your brief), MOTION_INSPIRATION_CLEAN_WORDMARK (Minimal & type: Spacious layouts, expressive typography and focused graphic reveals), MOTION_INSPIRATION_PRODUCT_DEMOS (Product demos: Interface walkthroughs, cursor actions and clear feature demonstrations), MOTION_INSPIRATION_DARK_SAAS (Immersive SaaS: Layered interfaces, dramatic depth and polished feature launches), MOTION_INSPIRATION_WARM_LAUNCH (Mixed media: Photography, cutouts and textures woven into animated graphics), MOTION_INSPIRATION_FOOTAGE_LED (Footage-led: People, places and product footage with supporting motion graphics), MOTION_INSPIRATION_MASCOT (Mascot: A character mascot that acts and talks over clean product UI), MOTION_INSPIRATION_EDITORIAL (Editorial: Paper collage, archive photos, highlighted documents and maps, like a news explainer), MOTION_INSPIRATION_DIAGRAM (Diagram: Step-by-step schematics and labelled parts that build an idea), MOTION_INSPIRATION_ILLUSTRATED (Illustrated: Flat illustrated scenes and characters that turn each idea into a picture), MOTION_INSPIRATION_DATA_STORY (Data story: Charts, counters, rankings and maps that make numbers mean something), MOTION_INSPIRATION_MAPS (Maps: Animated maps: borders, routes and zooms from the world down to a city). Leave it out for Auto.

search.description: video-to-clips: true adds B-roll to the clips.

useProvidedInOrder.description: Map `media.provided` items to script sections in order. Forces provided-media-only mode. Fewer media groups adjacent script sections; extra media are ignored.

videoModel.description: Video generation model: base, pro, ultra, veo3, sora2, seedance-25-1080p, seedance-1080p, seedance-4k, minimax-h3-768p, minimax-h3-2k, wan-3-1080p. The Ultra variants (seedance-1080p, seedance-4k, ...) pick the model and resolution of the ultra tier; sora2 is retired and runs on Veo 3. For media.type motion-graphics the director tiers match the create form, base (the form's Low, directed by Sonnet 5.5, 2 credits/s; alias low), pro (default, Opus 5.5, 3 credits/s) and ultra (Opus 5.5 at maximum effort, 5 credits/s), 15s minimum per generation; veo3/sora2/the Ultra variants are mapped to pro. character-swap: base (Wan 3.0, default), pro (Seedance 2.5) or ultra (MiniMax Recast, swaps public figures too).

music.description: Recommended for background music: `music: { generateMusic: true }`. Revid generates an original instrumental track from this video's script, so it fits the topic and mood (20 credits per started minute of video). Add `music.generationMusicPrompt` to steer the mood, tempo and instruments. Use `music.trackName` only when the user asks for a specific library track: an agent cannot listen to the library, so a track picked by name rarely fits the video. With music on and no track, file or generated music, the neutral `Presentation` track plays. To make the music quieter or louder, set `music.volume` to `low`, `normal` or `high`, or to an exact level from 0 to 100.

generateMusic.description: Recommended way to add background music: generates an original instrumental track from this video's script, so it fits the video. Turns music on by itself.

generationMusicPrompt.description: Optional brief for generated music: mood, tempo, instruments. Without it, the brief is written from the video's script.

trackName.description: Library track name. Only when the user asks for a specific track: you cannot listen to the library, so prefer `generateMusic: true`.

volume.description: How loud the music plays: low (half the workflow's level), normal (default), high (twice, up to 100), or an exact level from 0 to 100 (0 turns the music off). Does not turn music on by itself.

clipDuration.description: video-to-clips: target length of each AI-picked clip, in seconds. Default 60.

clipRange.description: video-to-clips: clip one exact time range instead of AI-picked moments, as "start:end" in seconds ("30:90", or "30:end" to run to the end). At least 10 seconds, always a single clip. character-swap: the part of the source to swap (up to 2 minutes).

coverStyle.description: Look of the title on a layers cover. Omit for the plain title box.

outputCount.description: audio-to-video and video-to-clips: how many clips to extract, 1 to 3. Other workflows always produce a single video.

searchQuery.description: video-to-clips: what the AI should look for when it picks the clips.

speakerCount.description: lyrics-to-video with music.enableLyricsLipSync: how many singers the lip sync detects. Default auto.

videoEditor.description: video-to-clips: true has the AI video editor turn the clip's key lines into motion graphics with camera moves. One clip, at its own flat price.

videoEditorInstructions.description: video-to-clips: how the AI video editor should cut the clip.

videoEditorStyle.description: video-to-clips with videoEditor: the edit's look. clean (default): calm graphics and cards in the captions' colour. bold: punchy words beside the speaker in white and a colour picked for the video, a sticker on the line that hits hardest. paper: hand-made notes and cream cards.

videoEditorAiPictures.description: video-to-clips with videoEditor: AI pictures where the talk calls for one, on top of the edit's price. off (default), pictures (4 credits each) or moving (per second at videoEditorVideoModel).

videoEditorVideoModel.description: video-to-clips with videoEditorAiPictures moving: the model that moves the pictures. Default base.

videoEditorSoundEffects.description: video-to-clips with videoEditor: short sounds on each graphic, card and cut in the bold and paper styles. Default true.

prompt.description: What the video is about. lyrics-to-video: a description of the song to write. song-ad: the ad to write (product or its page, audience, outcome). character-swap: optional instructions on top of the swap.

text.description: The exact script. lyrics-to-video and song-ad: the lyrics, sung as written.

url.description: Source URL. character-swap: the video whose people are replaced (file URL, or YouTube, TikTok or Instagram link).

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.title: Upload a file
tools.description: Get a public cdn.revid.ai URL for a local image, video or audio file, to use wherever Revid takes a media URL (render_video media and references, generate_media references and frames, create_character, clone_voice). This server cannot read your files: the call returns a one-time `uploadUrl`; PUT the file bytes to it with the returned headers within `expiresIn` seconds, e.g. `curl -X PUT -H "Content-Type: <contentType>" --data-binary @<path> "<uploadUrl>"`. The file is then served at `url`. With a shell and the Revid CLI, `revid upload <file>` does both steps. Without a way to send the bytes, ask the user for a public link instead. Uses no credits.

contentType.description: MIME type of the file: image/*, video/* or audio/*, e.g. image/jpeg, video/mp4, audio/mpeg. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Type.

fileName.description: Original file name; its extension is kept in the URL.

tools.name: create_episode
tools.title: Make a series episode
tools.description: Make a whole episode of a series with Revid's Series Maker, on Autopilot: the server plans the story and shot list, draws each character, place and prop once, generates every scene clip with them so they look the same in every scene, and assembles the episode with music, captions and the series outro. Without `seriesId` this starts a new series; with a `seriesId` from `list_series` it makes that series' next episode with the same cast, places, style, ratio, model and language (do not send those then). Returns a `runId`: poll `get_episode_status` every 30 to 60 seconds (a whole episode usually takes 10 to 30 minutes). When it is done, call `export_video` with its `pid`, then `get_project_status` until `videoUrl`. Credits are charged per reference image and scene clip as they come back, never past `maxCredits` (default 2500): the run stops with status needs_attention first. Call `get_account` to check the balance before a long Ultra episode. Requires an active Revid plan.

prompt.description: What the episode is about, or for a new series what the show is: premise, characters, tone, what happens.

seriesId.description: Make this series' next episode (from `list_series`). Omit to start a new series.

style.description: Visual style of a new series. Default: default (Revid picks from the prompt).

ratio.description: Aspect ratio of a new series. Default 9:16.

videoModel.description: Video tier of a new series, per 5 s of video: low 15 credits (cheapest), pro 50 (default), ultra 100 (Seedance 2.5, best acting, scenes up to 30 s).

durationSeconds.description: Whole episode length in seconds, outro included, in 5 s steps. Omit for Auto.

language.description: Spoken language of a new series (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, fr, es). Default: the prompt's language.

maxCredits.description: The most this episode may spend. Default 2500.

tools.name: get_episode_status
tools.title: Get episode status
tools.description: Follow a Series Maker run from `create_episode`: status (queued, running, done, needs_attention, failed, cancelled), step (plan, approve_plan, budget, references, scenes, assemble, done), credits, and once planned the episode's title and scenes. When done, `pid` is the editor project: export it with `export_video`. needs_attention means it stopped before spending more; `message` says why. Requires an active Revid plan.

tools.name: list_series
tools.title: List series
tools.description: List the account's Series Maker series (newest first) with their style, ratio, video model and episode count. Pass a `seriesId` to `create_episode` to make its next episode with the same characters and places. Requires an active Revid plan.

tools.name: cancel_episode
tools.title: Cancel episode
tools.description: Stop a Series Maker run from `create_episode`: the step in progress finishes (what it generates is charged), nothing after it starts. Requires an active Revid plan.

tools.name: get_project_status
tools.title: Get project status
tools.description: Fetch the current status for an existing Revid project id (`pid`). Requires an active Revid plan.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects owned by the authenticated API key user.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Revid account behind the API key: credits left, plan and subscription status, and the workspace.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.title: List voices
tools.description: List the narration voices of the Revid voice picker (gender, accent, age, language, preview URL) to pick `voice.voiceId` for `render_video`. The account's cloned voices come first.

category.description: premade (default): Revid's curated voices. all: the whole public catalog.

search.description: Words to find in the name or description, e.g. calm, deep.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.title: List presets
tools.description: List the style presets of Revid's create form: visual presets (`media.mediaPreset` for moving-image and ai-video), motion graphics categories (`media.mediaPreset` for motion-graphics) and caption presets (`captions.preset`).

search.description: Words to find in the preset name or guide, e.g. anime, pixar.

tools.name: list_music_tracks
tools.title: List music tracks
tools.description: List the background music library (`music.trackName` for `render_video`) with moods, descriptions and lengths. Use it only when the user asks for a library track: you cannot listen to them, so `music.generateMusic: true` is the better default.

instrumental.description: true for instrumental tracks only, false for tracks with words.

mood.description: A mood, e.g. calm, energetic. The response lists them.

search.description: Words to find in the name or description, e.g. piano.

tools.name: search_viral_videos
tools.title: Search viral videos
tools.description: Search viral short-form videos and posts across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Threads, and LinkedIn (same engine as revid.ai/search). Semantic query plus filters on engagement (min likes/views/shares/comments), platform, language, hashtags, posting date, duration, and AI-analyzed style (mood, content type, perspective, shooting style, visual origin, brand promotion). Each result includes the post URL, a playable video URL when available, the full transcript, a content summary, engagement counts and rate, author info, and hashtags — useful for studying what works before creating content with render_video. Rate limited per plan (free keys get a small daily allowance); a RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error says when the allowance resets.

query.description: Free-text semantic query, e.g. 'AI tools for founders'. Matches meaning, not just keywords.

platforms.description: Platforms to search. Defaults to youtube, instagram, tiktok.

viralOnly.description: Only posts in the 'high' or 'viral' engagement tier. TikTok has no tier data, so TikTok results need 100k+ likes instead.

hashtags.description: Hashtags (without #) — results must include at least one.

visualOrigin.description: Real shot vs AI generated vs animation.

hasBrandPromotion.description: Filter for videos with (true) or without (false) brand promotion.

minDuration.description: Minimum duration in seconds (TikTok results only).

maxDuration.description: Maximum duration in seconds (TikTok results only). Default 900.

postedAfter.description: Only posts after this date (ISO date or unix seconds).

postedBefore.description: Only posts before this date (ISO date or unix seconds).

limit.description: Results to return (max 12 per call — backend hard cap).

tools.name: calculate_credits
tools.title: Calculate credits
tools.description: Estimate credits from either a legacy `creationParams` payload or the same v3 payload used by `render_video`.

tools.name: export_video
tools.title: Export video
tools.description: Export an mp4 for an existing Revid project, with the export modal's resolution, frame rate and compression settings. The call waits up to 40 seconds. An export done by then returns status "ready" with its videoUrl. A longer render (most videos over a minute, 4k) returns status "processing" with an exportId: call `get_export_status` with it until ready or failed. Do not call export_video again for the same project while it is processing: every call charges a new export. Requires an active Revid plan.

compression.description: low (default, sharpest), medium or high (lightest file), or a CRF from 0 to 51.

fileName.description: Optional export filename. `.mp4` is added automatically if missing.

resolution.description: Export resolution. 4k costs 10 extra credits. Omit to keep the project's own (720p by default).

tools.name: get_export_status
tools.title: Get export status
tools.description: Follow an `export_video` call that returned status "processing": pass its exportId. Waits up to waitSeconds (default 40) for the render, then returns status "ready" with the videoUrl, "failed" with the reason, or still "processing" with the render's progress (0 to 1): then call it again. Renders usually take 1 to 10 minutes; one still rendering after an hour fails with Timeout. Requires an active Revid plan.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the render before answering, 0 to 40. Default 40; 0 checks once.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.title: Rename project
tools.description: Rename an existing Revid project.

tools.name: duplicate_project
tools.title: Duplicate project
tools.description: Duplicate an existing Revid project: same content and folder, a new project id. Uses no credits.

name.description: Name of the copy. Default: the original name + " (duplicated)".

tools.name: delete_project
tools.title: Delete project
tools.description: Delete a Revid project: it leaves the project list and its public page goes offline. A project still generating cannot be deleted. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: set_project_visibility
tools.title: Set project visibility
tools.description: Set who can watch a project's public page (revid.ai/view/<pid>): public (on and listed), unlisted (anyone with the link) or private (page off). Returns the public URL.

tools.name: clone_voice
tools.title: Clone voice
tools.description: Clone a custom voice from a public sample URL. Requires an Elite plan or better on Revid.

tools.name: list_characters
tools.title: List characters
tools.description: List saved consistent characters available to the authenticated user. Requires an active Revid plan.

tools.name: create_character
tools.title: Create character
tools.description: Create a new consistent character from a PNG or JPEG image URL. Requires an active Revid plan.

description.description: Character description used by the AI.

imageUrl.description: Public PNG or JPEG image URL.

tools.name: delete_character
tools.title: Delete character
tools.description: Delete a saved consistent character or trained character by id. Requires an active Revid plan.

tools.name: list_social_accounts
tools.title: List social accounts
tools.description: List the social accounts (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, Facebook Pages, webhooks) and channels connected to the Revid account or active workspace, without tokens. Call this before `publish_now` or `schedule_publish` to pick a destination: pass accounts[].id as `<platform>.id` (or accounts[].username as `<platform>.username`, `facebook.name` for Pages), or channels[].id as `channelId`. Accounts with tokenInvalid: true must be reconnected by the user in Revid settings before publishing. Facebook Pages publishing is restricted to admins and the designated Meta review account while Meta review is pending. It is not generally available, and changing plans does not unlock Facebook Connect. Use only connected Pages returned by list_social_accounts.

tools.name: schedule_publish
tools.title: Schedule publish
tools.description: Schedule a rendered video for the selected channel or connected accounts (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, Facebook Pages, webhook). Pass `scheduledTime` to publish at an exact date and time; omit it to use the next open queue slot. Use `list_social_accounts` first to find ids and handles. Facebook Pages publishing is restricted to admins and the designated Meta review account while Meta review is pending. It is not generally available, and changing plans does not unlock Facebook Connect. Use only connected Pages returned by list_social_accounts.
